# cmccloudv2_kafka_configuration (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# create master_slave kafka configuration
resource "cmccloudv2_kafka_configuration" "kafka_conf_1" {   
    name             = "kafka-config-5sac"
    database_engine  = "Kafka"
    database_version = "3.7"
    database_mode    = "single_node"
    description      = "template for Single Node kafka database"
    parameters       = {
        "transaction.state.log.segment.bytes"    = "104857600"
        "transactional.id.expiration.ms"   = "604800000"
    }
}
# create cluster kafka configuration
resource "cmccloudv2_kafka_configuration" "kafka_conf_2" {   
    name             = "kafka-config-a38d"
    database_engine  = "Kafka"
    database_version = "3.7"
    database_mode    = "cluster"
    description      = "template for Cluster kafka database"
    parameters       = {
        "replica.lag.time.max.ms"    = "30000"
        "log.index.interval.bytes"   = "4096"
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_mode` (String) The database mode of the Kafka configuration, `single_node`, `cluster`
- `database_version` (String) The database version of the Kafka configuration. Example `3.7`
- `name` (String) The name of the Redis configuration
- `parameters` (Map of String) List of the parameters for the Kafka configuration

### Optional

- `database_engine` (String) The database engine of the Kafka configuration, Kafka
- `description` (String) The description of the Kafka configuration
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
